growth_signal.value: Went from a €4.7M seed round in 2023 to a €14M Series A, then to a €131.7M credit facility in 2026 to fund inventory.

entry.idea: Buying and selling scrap copper and aluminium is slow, offline and full of middlemen, so METYCLE built a digital trading platform that sources, buys and supplies secondary (recycled) copper and aluminium.
entry.lesson: Digitize an old, offline trading market, then use debt financing rather than just equity to fund the physical inventory the marketplace needs to actually trade.
entry.name: METYCLE

growth.basis: substitute: funding round much bigger than the last
growth.reason: Funding jumped sharply from a €4.7M seed round in 2023 to a €131.7M credit facility in 2026, a clear sign it is scaling fast.

market.reason: Copper and aluminium recycling is a large, global industrial market, not just a local niche.

tech.reason: It combines a trading platform with sourcing logistics, which is solid engineering and operations but something a well-funded competitor could rebuild within a year or two.

entry.twist: It doesn't just match buyers and sellers online, it uses large credit facilities to actually buy and hold scrap metal itself, so it can guarantee supply the way a trading company would.
entry.who_pays: Metal traders, scrapyards and manufacturers pay to buy and sell copper and aluminium scrap through the platform.
entry.why_now: Manufacturers want recycled metal to cut carbon emissions and reduce reliance on mining, so demand for a fast, digital way to source secondary copper and aluminium is growing.
